sc_cat_item.description: The 'Temporary Hardware Request' catalog item is designed to facilitate the short-term allocation of hardware resources to employees for specific projects, events, or during peak operational periods. This service ensures that all team members have the necessary tools to perform their tasks efficiently without the long-term commitment of purchasing new equipment.
